Deal_Headline: Les Laboratoires Servier Acquires Symphogen
Financial_Advisors: Lazard Inc , Rothschild & Co Bank AG
Legal_Advisors: Plesner , McDermott Will & Emery LLP , Perkins Coie LLP , Gorrissen Federspiel Advokatpartnerselskab
Description:
Les Laboratoires Servier SA, a pharmaceutical company, has completed the acquisition of Symphogen A/S, a therapeutic antibody discovery company.

Following the transaction, Symphogen will now function as the antibody center of excellence of Servier in several different therapeutic areas including oncology. Symphogen, now a subsidiary of Servier, will keep its operational autonomy and continue to rely on its experienced employees while maintaining its headquarters in Ballerup, Denmark.

As part of the acquisition, Christophe Thurieau, Executive Director of Servier Research Institute, has been appointed Chief Executive Officer of Symphogen and Karin Garre, former Chief Operating Officer of Symphogen, has been appointed General Manager of Symphogen. Martin Olin, former Chief Executive Officer of Symphogen, will act as an external consultant to support this transition.

This transaction enables Servier to strengthen its R&D pipeline by acquiring antibody pipeline and next-generation antibody technologies.

Lazard acted as financial advisor, while McDermott Will & Emery and Gorrissen Federspiel Advokatpartnerselskab acted as legal advisors to Servier. Rothschild & Co. acted as financial advisor and Plesner Advokatpartnerselskab and Perkins Coie LLP acted as legal advisors to Symphogen.

Deal History:

Announced: On April 3, 2020, Les Laboratoires Servier entered into a definitive agreement with the owners of Symphogen.
Deal_Rationale: This transaction enables Servier to strengthen its R&D pipeline by acquiring antibody pipeline and next-generation antibody technologies.

Towa Pharmaceutical Co. Deal_Headline: Pfizer Acquires Therachon for USD810 Million
Legal_Advisors: Cooley LLP , Homburger AG , Lenz & Staehelin , Arnold & Porter LLP
Description:
Pfizer Inc., a pharmaceutical company, has completion acquisition of all the shares of Therachon Holding AG, a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on rare diseases with assets in development for the treatment of achondroplasia and short bowel syndrome (SBS).

Under the terms of the transaction, Pfizer acquired Therachon for USD340 million with an additional USD470 million in additional payments contingent on the achievement of key milestones in the development and commercialization of TA-46. 

TA-46 is an investigational, soluble recombinant human fibroblast growth factor receptor 3 (FGFR3) decoy, for bone development abnormalities associated with achondroplasia.

Prior to the closing of the transaction with Pfizer, Therachon will spin-off its apraglutide development program into a separate, independent company. Apraglutide is a GLP-2 analog in Phase II development for short bowel syndrome. Pfizer Ventures, the venture capital arm of Pfizer Inc., currently holds a minority stake and will continue to hold an equity stake in the new company.

The transaction is not expected to impact Pfizer’s current 2019 adjusted financial guidance.

The acquisition enables Pfizer to expand its rare disease portfolio with potential first-in-class therapy for achondroplasia through the development of TA-46.

Goldman Sachs acted as financial advisor while Cooley LLP and Homburger AG acted as legal advisors to Therachon. Arnold & Porter and Lenz & Staehelin acted as legal advisors to Pfizer.

Deal History:

Announced: On May 8, 2019, Pfizer entered into a definitive agreement to acquire all the shares of Therachon.
Deal_Rationale: The acquisition enables Pfizer to expand its rare disease portfolio with potential first-in-class therapy for achondroplasia through the development of TA-46.

Financial_Advisors: Rothschild & Co SCA , The Goldman Sachs Group Inc , Deutsche Bank AG , J.P. Morgan Cazenove Ltd (Inactive) , Barclays Wealth Management , Goldman Sachs International
Legal_Advisors: Shearman & Sterling LLP , Simpson Thacher & Bartlett LLP , Allen Overy Shearman Sterling LLP , Travers Smith LLP , White & Case LLP , Arnold & Porter Kaye Scholer LLP
Description:
Boston Scientific Corp, a medical technology, through its wholly-owned subsidiary, Bravo Bidco Ltd, has completed the acquisition of BTG plc,  a company which develops and commercializes products used in minimally-invasive procedures targeting cancer and vascular diseases, as well as acute care pharmaceuticals, for GBP3.3 billion.

In addition to the Interventional Medicine product lines, the BTG portfolio also includes a specialty pharmaceutical business comprised of acute care antidotes to treat overexposure to certain medications and toxins, and a licensing business that receives royalties related to BTG intellectual property and product license agreements.

Upon the effectiveness of the scheme of arrangement, BTG became a wholly-owned subsidiary of Boston Scientific, and BTG shares no longer trade on the London Stock Exchange. Under the terms of the previously announced transaction, holders of BTG common shares will receive 840 pence in cash per share. 

The transaction would be funded with a combination of cash on hand and proceeds from debt financing entered into by Boston Scientific.

The acquisition will enable Bravo Bidco to expand peripheral interventions portfolio with minimally-invasive treatments for cancers and vascular conditions.

Goldman Sachs International, Deutsche Bank AG, J.P. Morgan Cazenove and Rothschild & Co acted as financial advisors where as Allen & Overy LLP acted as legal adviser to BTG, while Barclays acted as financial advisor where as Shearman & Sterling LLP, Simpson Thacher & Bartlett LLP, Arnold & Porter Kaye Scholer LLP and Travers Smith LLP acted as legal advisors, respectively, to Bravo Bidco.

Deal History:

Announced: On November 20, 2018, Boston Scientific reached an agreement on the terms of a recommended cash offer by its wholly-owned subsidiary, Bravo Bidco Ltd, for the acquisition of the entire issued and to be issued ordinary share capital (100%) of BTG plc, a company which develops and commercializes products used in minimally-invasive procedures targeting cancer and vascular diseases, as well as acute care pharmaceuticals, for GBP3.3 billion.

Update: On December 12, 2018, BTG, Boston Scientific and Bidco entered into an amendment to the Co-operation Agreement to extend the date by which certain regulatory filings must be made in Spain, Germany and other relevant jurisdictions. The filing of the notification in respect of the Acquisition under the HSR Act was made yesterday.

Update: On February 15, 2019, The Transaction has received merger control clearance in Germany under the German Act Against Restraints of Competition and the Taiwan Fair Trade Commission has terminated its investigation. 

Update: On February 28, 2019, The shareholders of BTG have approved in respect of the previously announced recommended cash offer to acquire the entire issued and to be issued ordinary share capital of BTG by Bravo Bidco, an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary of Boston Scientific.

Update: On August 2, 2019, BTG and Boston Scientific are pleased to confirm that the Transaction has received merger control clearance from the US Federal Trade Commission under the HSR Act, on July 25, 2019 the CNMC issued a clearance decision under the Spanish Competition Act and on August 2, 2019, the Federal Competition Authority of Austria issued a clearance decision pursuant to Sec 11 Para 4 Austrian Cartel Act.
Deal_Rationale: The acquisition will enable Bravo Bidco to expand peripheral interventions portfolio with minimally-invasive treatments for cancers and vascular conditions.

Deal_Headline: Aphria Acquires CC Pharma
Description:
Aphria Inc., a global cannabis company, has completed the acquisition of CC Pharma GmbH, a distributor of pharmaceutical products.

Deal_Headline: Ingenza Acquires Stake in Amprologix
Description:
Ingenza Ltd, an industrial biotechnology and synthetic biology company, has acquired a stake in Amprologix Ltd, a spin-out company from the University of Plymouth.

Amprologix develops and commercialises epidermicins, a new class of antibiotics capable of rapidly killing harmful bacteria, including methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA), Streptoccus and Enterococcus at very low doses.

The acquisition enables Ingenza to discover and improve new antimicrobial classes.

Deal_Headline: Telix Pharma Acquires Atlab Pharma for USD10 Million
Description:
Telix Pharmaceuticals Limited, a clinical-stage biotechnology company, has completed the acquisition of Atlab Pharma SAS, a biotechnology company, for a purchase consideration of USD10 million.

Telix Pharma has exercised an option to acquire Atlab Pharma.  A total of 14,840,000 shares were issued in consideration. The consideration of USD10 million is issued as USD9 million in Telix shares to Atlab shareholders, at USD0.89 per share, USD0.5 million in Telix shares to BZL, also at USD0.89 per share. These shares are paid to BZL as partial consideration for a significant reduction in royalty rates for the background IP, as a closing condition of the transaction, and USD0.5 million in warrants over Telix shares to BZL, with an exercise price of USD1.34 per share.

As part of the transaction, Telix Pharma has also entered into a limited back - license with BZL Biologics LLC(BZL) for certain IP rights to support ongoing commercial research activities that are outside of the scope of product development focus for Telix Pharma. Prof. Jean-Francois Chatal (Atlab/ Universite de Nantes) and Prof. Neil Bander (BZL/ WCMC ) will continue to serve as members of Telix’s scientific advisory board.

The transaction enables Telix Pharma to support potential indication expansion for TLX591, notably the combination use of anti-PSMA therapeutics in conjunction with anti-androgen drugs, further increasing the value and relevance of its TLX591 program; Atlab Pharma possesses rights to an extensive clinical data set in approximately 200 patients that is highly informative to the development of TLX591, including unpublished data around dose optimization schemes for antibody-based PSMA radiopharmaceuticals. This data may accelerate and further de-risk the future development of TLX591; Atlab Pharma and BZL, together, bring considerable knowledge and expertise to the Telix team; and Atlab possesses the rights and materials necessary to develop huJ591, the most widely clinically-studied anti-PSMA antibody. Telix will keep huJ591 as a back-up clinical drug candidate and continue to support several high-value academic collaborations around the use of this antibody that may also be informative to the future development of TLX591, including in non-prostate cancer indications.

Deal_Headline: Sanofi Acquires Ablynx for USD4.85 Billion
Financial_Advisors: Morgan Stanley , Lazard Inc , J.P. Morgan Securities LLC
Legal_Advisors: Eubelius , Goodwin Procter LLP , Linklaters LLP , Weil, Gotshal & Manges LLP , NautaDutilh NV
Description:
Sanofi, a pharmaceutical company, has acquired all outstanding shares of Ablynx NV, a biopharmaceutical company focused on the discovery and development of nanobodies, for an aggregate equity value of approximately EUR3.9 billion (USD4.85 billion). 

The Squeeze-out period commenced on May 22, 2018, in accordance with applicable Belgian and the US law, following the acquisition by Sanofi of over 95% of the outstanding shares of Ablynx upon settlement of the initial acceptance period of its tender offer for Ablynx. On June 12, 2018, upon expiration of the Squeeze-out period, 2,893,201 shares (including 7,163 shares represented by ADSs) and 8 convertible bonds of Ablynx were tendered in the Squeeze-out. The securities tendered during the Squeeze-out period are expected to be settled on or about June 19, 2018.

All shares (including all shares represented by ADSs) and all convertible bonds of Ablynx not tendered during the Squeeze-out are deemed transferred to Sanofi by operation of law. The funds required for the payment of the price thereof are kept with the Bank for official deposits (Deposito- en Consignatiekas / Caisse des depots et consignations). The former Ablynx holders of these Securities retain the right to receive EUR45 (USD55.92) per share (or ADS) and EUR393,700.78 per convertible bond. In order to receive these amounts, they must contact the bank for official deposits, where the funds will remain available.

On June 13, 2018, The shares of Ablynx were delisted from the regulated market of Euronext Brussels, (ii) the ADSs were delisted from NASDAQ Global Select Market and (iii) the convertible bonds were delisted from the open market Frankfurt MTF (Freiverkehr).

In accordance with the Belgian requirement of certainty of funds, Sanofi has entered into a bank credit facility, BNP Paribas Fortis SA/NA acting as the sole credit facility arranger. 

This transaction enables Sanofi to strengthen its R&D strategy with Nanobody technology platform and expands its rare blood disorders franchise with Ablynx’s late-stage investigational caplacizumab aTTP treatment. 

Morgan Stanley and Lazard Ltd. acted as financial advisors, Weil, Gotshal & Manges LLP and NautaDutilh NV acted as legal advisors to Sanofi; J.P. Morgan Securities LLC acted as financial advisor, while Eubelius CVBA, Goodwin Procter LLP and Linklaters LLP acted as legal advisors to Ablynx for the transaction.

Deal History:

Update: On May 14, 2018, Sanofi and Ablynx  announced the results of the initial tender offer period of Sanofi’s previously announced tender offers to acquire all of the outstanding shares (including shares represented by American Depositary Shares (ADSs)), warrants and convertible bonds (together, the Securities) of Ablynx.

Update: On March 29, 2018, Sanofi entered into definitive agreement with Ablynx to acquire all of the outstanding ordinary shares of Ablynx at a price per share of EUR45 (USD55.92) in cash, which represents an aggregate equity value of approximately EUR3.9 billion (USD4.85). The transaction was unanimously approved by both the Sanofi and Ablynx boards of directors. Sanofi and Ablynx have received an approval and publication of the tender offer documents and response by Ablynx’s Board of Directors.

Sanofi confirmed that, as of the expiration of the initial acceptance period, which expired on May 4, 2018, a total of 71,972,994 shares (including 7,446,312 shares represented by ADSs), 2,594,841 warrants and 975 convertible bonds had been validly tendered into the offers and not withdrawn. Sanofi will own 95.60% of the outstanding shares of Ablynx on the settlement date of the offers, of which more than 90% were acquired through the offers. Sanofi further confirmed that the Minimum tender condition and the other conditions to the offers have been satisfied.

Under the terms of the agreement, Sanofi will commence the tender offers to acquire all of the outstanding shares (includes shares represented by ADS), warrants and convertible bonds of Ablynx in cash for  EUR45 (USD55.6) per share or ADS; EUR18.66 (USD23) - EUR41.79 (USD51.6) per warrant; and EUR0.39 (USD0.48) per convertible bond. Sanofi has complied with the formalities set forth in the Belgian takeover legislation and filed the mandatory documents with the FSMA.

Update: On March 27, 2018, Sanofi and Ablynx have received prospectus approved by the Belgian Financial Services and Markets Authority (FSMA).

Update: On March 1, 2018, Sanofi announced that the waiting period under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act of 1976 has expired and that Sanofi has received clearance from the Federal Cartel Office of Germany in accordance with the Act Against Restraints of Competition, applicable to the transaction.

Earlier on January 5, 2018,  Ablynx rejected the proposal from Novo Nordisk A/S for up to EUR30.5 (USD36.2) per share, including EUR28 (USD33.23) per share in cash and one CVR with total potential cash payments over time of up to EUR2.5 (USD2.97) per share or total equity valuation of EUR2.6 billion (USD3.09 billion), taking into account the interests of all its stakeholders, unanimously concluded that the proposal fundamentally undervalues Ablynx and its strong prospects for continued growth and value creation.
Deal_Rationale: This transaction enables Sanofi to strengthen its R&D strategy with Nanobody technology platform and expands its rare blood disorders franchise with Ablynx’s late-stage investigational caplacizumab aTTP treatment.

Deal_Headline: Takeda Pharma Acquires TiGenix for USD626.4 Million
Financial_Advisors: Cowen and Company, LLC (Inactive) , Centerview Partners UK LLP
Legal_Advisors: Covington & Burling LLP , DLA Piper US LLP , Davis Polk & Wardwell LLP , DLA Piper UK LLP , Osborne Clarke N.V.
Description:
Takeda Pharmaceutical Co. Ltd., a pharmaceutical company, has completed the acquisition of TiGenix NV, a biopharmaceutical company developing stem cell therapies for serious medical conditions, for a purchase consideration of approximately EUR520 million (USD626.4 million). Takeda Pharma intends to fund the transaction cost from existing cash balances.

Pursuant to the transaction, TiGenix becomes a wholly owned subsidiary of Takeda.

On June 6, 2018, Takeda Pharma announced the results of the first acceptance period of Takeda’s previously announced tender offer in cash for all outstanding ordinary shares, warrants and American Depositary Shares (ADSs) and together with the ordinary shares and the warrants, the securities) of TiGenix that are not yet owned by Takeda and its affiliates, which expired as scheduled on May 31, 2018.

The second acceptance period for the Belgian offer will commence on June 20, 2018, and the second acceptance period for the US offer will commence today, June 6, 2018, and is scheduled to expire for both the Belgian offer and the US offer, subject to any extension, on July 3, 2018, respectively. The results of the second acceptance period are expected to be published on July 6, 2018. Payment for the ordinary shares, warrants and ADSs validly tendered and not withdrawn in the second acceptance period is currently expected to commence on July 10, 2018.

During the second acceptance period, holders of ordinary shares, warrants and ADSs can tender their securities in the bid by following the instructions set out in the prospectus or the tender offer statement on schedule TO, as applicable to them.

On April 25, 2018, Takeda Pharma announced that the first acceptance period of tender offer in cash for all outstanding ordinary shares. warrants and ADSs of TiGenix that are not yet owned by Takeda and its affiliates, at an acquisition price of EUR1.78 per ordinary share in cash; EUR35.60 (USD42.8) per ADS in cash and an amount per warrant in cash depending on the strike price and maturity of such Warrant, will commence on April 30, 2018.

The first acceptance period for the bid will start on April 30, 2018 and is scheduled to expire, subject to any extension, on May 31, 2018. The results of the first acceptance period are expected to be published on June 6, 2018. Payment for the ordinary shares, warrants and ADSs validly tendered and not withdrawn in the first acceptance period is currently scheduled for June 8, 2018 although the Belgian offer and the US offer may have different payment dates.

During the first acceptance period, holders of ordinary shares, warrants and ADSs can tender their securities in the bid by following the instructions set out in the prospectus or the tender offer statement on schedule TO, as applicable to them.

Pursuant to the transaction, Takeda Pharma intends to acquire 100% of the securities with voting rights or giving access to voting rights of TiGenix not already owned by Takeda Pharma or its affiliates at an acquisition price of EUR1.78 (USD2.14) per share in cash and an equivalent price per American Depositary Share (ADS), warrant and convertible bond, representing a transaction value of approximately EUR520 million (USD626.44 million) on a fully diluted basis. The transaction is structured as an all cash voluntary public takeover bid by Takeda Pharma with respect to 100% of the securities with voting rights or giving access to voting rights of TiGenix that are not already owned by Takeda Pharma or its affiliates. 

Takeda Pharma and TiGenix entered into an offer and support agreement confirming TiGenix’s support and the terms and conditions of the bid. Gri-Cel SA, holding 32,238,178 TiGenix shares, and its affiliate Grifols Worldwide Operations Ltd., holding 7,189,800 TiGenix shares in the form of ADS, have irrevocably confirmed that they will tender their shares and ADSs into the potential public takeover bid. 

The acquisition extends an existing exclusive ex-US license, development and commercialization agreement between Takeda and TiGenix to develop and commercialize Cx601 (darvadstrocel) entered in July 2016.

This acquisition enables Takeda Pharma to expand its late stage gastroenterology pipeline and strengthen presence in the US specialty care market.

Centerview Partners UK LLP acted as financial advisor, DLA Piper UK LLP and DLA Piper US LLP acted as legal advisor to Takeda Pharma; Cowen and Company, LLC acted as financial advisor, while Osborne Clarke CVBA and Davis Polk & Wardwell LLP acted as legal advisor to Tingenix for the transaction.

Deal History:

Announced: On January 5, 2018, Takeda Pharma intends to acquire TiGenix, for a purchase consideration of approximately EUR520 million (USD626.4 million). Takeda Pharma intends to fund the transaction cost from existing cash balances.

Takeda Pharma has also entered into an offer and support agreement with TiGenix which provides for a recommended potential voluntary public takeover bid for TiGenix. The agreement has been unanimously supported by the TiGenix board of directors (including its CEO).

The bid will be comprised of two separate offers (i) an offer to all holders of ordinary shares and warrants in accordance with the applicable law in Belgium (Belgian offer), and (ii) an offer to holders of ordinary shares who are resident in the US in accordance with applicable the US law and to holders of ADSs wherever located (the US offer).

Following closing of the potential voluntary public takeover bid, Takeda Pharma intends to launch a squeeze-out if the applicable conditions for such squeeze-out are met to delist the shares of TiGenix from Euronext Brussels and NASDAQ. After the squeeze-out, TiGenix would become a wholly-owned subsidiary of Takeda.
Deal_Rationale: This acquisition enables Takeda Pharma to expand its late stage gastroenterology pipeline and strengthen presence in the US specialty care market.

Deal_Headline: Cell Medica Acquires Catapult Therapy TCR from Cell Therapy Catapult
Description:
Cell Medica Ltd, a developer of cellular immunotherapy for the treatment of cancer, has acquired Catapult Therapy TCR Limited, a developer of cell therapy for the treatment of acute myeloid leukaemia, from Cell Therapy Catapult Ltd, (Cell and Gene Therapy Catapult), a developer of cell and gene therapies.

Catapult Therapy TCR is a company set up by Cell Therapy Catapult, University College London (UCL) Business and Imperial Innovations, and managed by Cell Therapy Catapult, for the development of the WT1 T cell receptor (TCR) cell therapy discovered through research at UCL and Imperial College London. The WT1-TCR cell therapy enhances the immune system to fight cancer by genetically engineering the patient’s T cells to target WT1, a tumour-associated antigen which is expressed in both solid tumours and blood cancers.

Concurrently, Cell Medica entered into a collaboration agreement with Cell Therapy Catapult, to establish cell therapy manufacturing operations for Cell Medica at the GMP production facility recently built by Cell Therapy Catapult in Stevenage, UK. The collaboration will include transferring the current WT1-TCR cell therapy manufacturing process to Stevenage over the next twelve months while Cell Medica and Cell Therapy Catapult work to develop a commercial scale production process using advanced manufacturing techniques. Cell Medica will also evaluate the feasibility of manufacturing additional cell therapy products at the site.

This transaction enables Cell Medica to create an effective treatment for patients with solid tumours.
Deal_Rationale: This transaction enables Cell Medica to create an effective treatment for patients with solid tumours.

Deal_Headline: Astellas Pharma Acquires Ogeda for up to USD852 Million
Description:
Astellas Pharma Inc., a pharmaceutical company, has completed the acquisition of Ogeda SA, a drug discovery company, for a cash consideration of up to EUR800 million (USD851.98 million).

Under the agreement, Astellas Pharma paid up to a total of EUR800 million (USD851.98 million). Astellas Pharma will make an initial payment of EUR500 million (USD532.5 million) in consideration of 100% of the equity in Ogeda at the closing of the agreement. Then Ogeda shareholders will be eligible to receive an additional EUR300 million (USD319.49 million) with attainment of certain clinical development and regulatory milestones for fezolinetant. Following the transaction, Ogeda became a wholly owned subsidiary of Astellas Pharma.

Fezolinetant, is a selective NK3 receptor antagonist, and the positive data from a Phase IIa study result for the non-hormonal treatment of menopause-related vasomotor symptoms (MR-VMS), announced in January 2017. 

This acquisition enables Astellas Pharma to expand its late stage pipeline and is expected to contribute to its mid-to-long term growth.

Jones Day acted as legal advisor to Astellas Pharma and White & Case LLP acted as legal advisor to Ogedas for the agreement.

Deal History:

Announced: On April 3, 2017, Astellas Pharma entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Ogeda, for a cash consideration of up to EUR800 million (USD851.98 million).
Deal_Rationale: This acquisition enables Astellas Pharma to expand its late stage pipeline and is expected to contribute to its mid-to-long term growth.

Deal_Headline: Boston Scientific Acquires Symetis for USD435 Million
Description:
Boston Scientific Corporation, a medical technology, has completed the acquisition Symetis SA, a medical technology company, for a purchase consideration of USD435 million in up-front cash.

The Symetis portfolio includes the ACURATE tA and ACURATE neo/TF valve systems for use in the treatment of high-risk patients suffering from severe and symptomatic aortic valve stenosis, which are sold in Europe and in other geographies outside of the United States. Symetis is also developing the ACURATE neo/AS next generation valve system, currently in a clinical trial intended to serve as the basis for a future CE mark application.

On an adjusted basis, the transaction is expected to be immaterial in 2017, slightly accretive in 2018, and increasingly accretive thereafter. The transaction is expected to be less accretive (or dilutive, as the case may be) on a GAAP basis, due to amortization expense and transaction and integration costs.

This transaction enables Boston Scientific to expand treatments for patients with aortic valvular heart disease and strengthen its position in structural heart globally.

Vischer AG acted as advisor to Symetis for the transaction.

Deal History:

Announced: On March 30, 2017, Boston Scientific entered into definitive agreement to acquire Symetis, for a purchase consideration of USD435 million in up-front cash.
Deal_Rationale: This transaction enables Boston Scientific to expand treatments for patients with aortic valvular heart disease and strengthen its position in structural heart globally.

Deal_Headline: BioLineRx Acquires Agalimmune
Description:
BioLineRx Ltd., a biopharmaceutical company focused on oncology and immunology, has acquired Agalimmune Ltd., a developer of anti-cancer immunotherapy, and its technology platform for a initial consideration of USD5.85 million, of which USD2.85 million is in cash and the remainder in the Company’s ADSs. Additional consideration may be due to Agalimmune shareholders based on certain development and commercial milestones, including future sales of Agalimmune products. The acquisition expands the Company’s pipeline with a number of assets, including Agalimmune’s primary asset, AGI-134, a novel immuno-oncology agent for various cancer indications at the near-clinical stage of development. Agalimmune also has a number of early-stage preclinical assets for future evaluation by the Company.

Agalimmune’s lead compound, AGI-134 is a synthetic alpha-Gal immunotherapy in development for solid tumors. Description:

Deal_Headline: Cadila Pharma Sweden Acquires BioChromix NewCo
Description:
Cadila Pharmaceuticals Ltd, an India-based leading research-driven pharmaceutical companies, has announced the acquisition of Swedish BioChromix NewCo AB through its subsidiary Cadila Pharmaceuticals Sverige AB. The subsidiary has recently been established to investigate and facilitate business interactions between Cadila Pharmaceuticals Ltd and potential collaborators, academic groups, etc.

BioChromix NewCo AB develops new and innovative treatments against diseases involving misfolded proteins, which are believed to be central in the development of certain neurodegenerative diseases. BioChromix NewCo's unique substance class is believed to selectively bind to, neutralize and eliminate soluble, toxic protein oligomers, protofibrils and soluble aggregates that are believed to contribute to the neurodegenerative process in several diseases that affect the nervous system.

Cadila Pharmaceuticals will continue the preclinical and clinical development of the drug candidates developed by BioChromix NewCo. According to the agreement, development is to be based on milestones and will be carried out at Cadila Pharmaceuticals' state-of-the-art research facility in Ahmedabad, India. Cadila Pharmaceuticals Ltd. has all the resources necessary to take the project to the clinical phase and on to the market.

"The acquisition makes it possible to take the project, which was previously carried out by BioChromix NewCo, forward with significant resources. Cadila's expertise in drug development, together with BioChromix NewCo's scientific know-how in its field, provides an excellent platform for the further development of these unique drug candidates Provided that the development is successful, opportunities are created to enter into valuable commercial agreements in important geographic markets such as the USA and Europe," says Dr. Peter Åsberg, outgoing CEO of BioChromix NewCo under the proposed name change to CPL BCX PHARMA AB.

"There is a lot of promising research going on around the world, especially in Europe, which complements our research portfolio in pharmaceuticals. The acquisition of BioChromix NewCo, through our Swedish subsidiary, is a step towards establishing new domestic solutions at our own high-class facility for the treatment of neurodegenerative diseases. This is an area of ??therapy that is of great importance to us," comments Dr. Rajiv I. Modi, Chairman and CEO of Cadila Pharmaceuticals.

"Going from the discovery electronic polymers interact with misfolded proteins in the university laboratory to medical innovation is a long step. The intellectual capital found in BioChromix NewCo was created through the transfer of university projects to the small development companies BioChromix AB and BioChromix Pharma AB. Cadila Pharmaceuticals' acquisition of BioChromix NewCo means that this knowledge is now transferred to an organization that can take the project to the clinic. I hope that it will ultimately lead to new treatments that can slow the progression of the disease and create a future benefit for patients suffering from these neurodegenerative diseases," says Olle Inganäs , one of the founders of BioChromix NewCo and professor at Linköping University.

Formerly BioChromix AB is part of UIC Alumni and has received advanced business development support through UIC's program UIC Business Accelerator .
Deal_Rationale: The acquisition of BioChromix NewCo, through Cadila's Swedish subsidiary, is a step towards establishing new domestic solutions at Cadila's own high-class facility for the treatment of neurodegenerative diseases.

Deal_Headline: ProductLife Group acquires Kohne Pharma
Description:
ProductLife Group (PLG), a France-based provider of life sciences consulting and outsourcing services, has acquired Kohne Pharma GmbH, a Germany-based regulatory and pharmacovigilance services provider. 

_x000d_ Pursuant to the transaction, Kohne Pharma will retain its brand and will be known as Kohne Pharma, a PLG company. Kohne's safety and regulatory functions will be managed, operated and aligned with the pan-European PLG functions.
Deal_Rationale:

 _x000d_
The acquisition will also allow PLG to increase its local presence in Germany and support its continued commitment to smart outsourcing.

Deal_Headline: Cardiome Pharma acquires Correvio
Description:
Cardiome Pharma Corp., a Canada-based biopharmaceutical company, has acquired Correvio International Sarl, a Switzerland-based pharmaceutical company. 

_x000d_ Under the terms of the agreement, Cardiome has acquired 100% of Correvio through the purchase of a combination of assets and shares of its subsidiaries in exchange for 19.9% of Cardiome's outstanding shares and a deferred cash consideration of $12 million. The total transaction is valued at approximately $23 million. 

_x000d_ The deferred cash consideration will be repaid monthly at an amount equal to 10% of cash receipts from product sales and any applicable interest accrued at 10% compounded annually. The adjusted deferred cash consideration must be repaid in full by December 1, 2019.
Deal_Rationale: The acquisition will provide Cardiome Pharma with an operational European platform, global distribution, complementary products and the financial flexibility required to launch its product BRINAVESS(TM).

Deal_Headline: PolyTherics acquires Antitope
Description:
PolyTherics Limited, a provider of technologies and services for the development of biopharmaceutical products, has acquired Antitope Limited, a biotechnology company. Both the companies are based in the UK. 

_x000d_ As part of the consideration, PolyTherics is issuing new shares up to an aggregate value of GBP13.5 million to fund the transaction and to provide working capital for the enlarged group. Imperial Innovations led the investment with further funds provided by Invesco Perpetual, Mercia Fund Management and Advantage Enterprise & Innovation Fund.  

_x000d_ Pursuant to the transaction, Antitope will operate as a wholly-owned subsidiary of PolyTherics.
Deal_Rationale: The transaction will allow PolyTherics to expand its drug development service offerings.

Deal_Headline: GlaxoSmithKline acquires Okairos
Description:
GlaxoSmithKline plc (GSK), a UK-based pharmaceutical, biologics, vaccines and consumer healthcare company, has acquired Okairos AG, a Switzerland-based developer of vaccine platform technologies, for $325 million in cash.

_x000d_The transaction also includes a small number of early stage assets. 

_x000d_Under the terms of the transaction, GSK will take full ownership of Okairos and thus assume ownership of early stage assets for diseases such as respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), hepatitis C virus (HCV), malaria, tuberculosis, ebola and HIV, supplementing Okairos’ existing vaccines pipeline. 

_x000d_Earlier, Okairos had secured funding from BioMedPartners AG, Boehringer Ingelheim Venture Fund, Life Science Partners (LSP), Novartis Venture Funds and Versant Ventures, Inc.
Deal_Rationale:
Okairos’ novel vaccine platform technology will enhance GSK’s development of new prophylactic vaccines (designed to prevent infection) as well as new classes of therapeutic vaccines (designed to treat infection or disease). _x000d_
_x000d_
Okairos’ technology complements GSK’s existing vaccine technology and expertise and will enable GSK to continue its work developing the next generation of vaccines.

Description:
